fact: At the Botswana Tech Summit on 13 August 2025 the Assistant Minister of Communications and Innovation said government was working on finalising a National Artificial Intelligence Policy, following an AI readiness exercise with UNESCO; no adoption is reported.
A Parliament of Botswana researcher writes that the Government of Botswana is advancing toward finalizing its first National Artificial Intelligence Policy, which the brief calls the draft AI Policy.
President Masisi said the Ministry of Communications, Knowledge and Technology is collaborating with Estonia to develop the Botswana Artificial Intelligence Strategy.
Botswana Information Technology Society president Tshepho Bathai said Botswana had developed and submitted a national AI policy to Parliament within a year; no adoption is stated.
Committee co-chair Mothusi Tladi says the ICT Sector Sub High Level Consultative Committee on 9 June 2026 was briefed on the AI Policy and its path to Cabinet approval.
